# LearnOpenCV

> Expert tutorials and guides for mastering computer vision, deep learning, and real-time object detection with OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and YOLO.

LearnOpenCV is a comprehensive resource for computer vision education founded by Satya Mallick, offering step-by-step tutorials, code examples, and practical guides for developers learning OpenCV, deep learning frameworks, and modern object detection techniques. The site covers everything from beginner fundamentals to advanced real-time deployment strategies.

## Key Topics

- OpenCV
- Computer Vision
- Deep Learning
- Neural Networks
- Object Detection
- YOLO
- TensorFlow
- PyTorch
- Face Detection
- Real-Time Processing
- Multi-Object Tracking
- YuNet
- Face Blur & Pixelation
- CNN
- Python

## Getting Started Guides

- [Getting Started with OpenCV](https://learnopencv.com/getting-started-with-opencv): Step-by-step beginner guide to OpenCV with code examples and real-world applications
- [Getting Started with PyTorch](https://learnopencv.com/getting-started-with-pytorch): Introductory tutorial for deep learning with PyTorch and neural networks
- [Getting Started with Keras & TensorFlow](https://learnopencv.com/getting-started-with-tensorflow-keras): Beginner guide to deep learning with TensorFlow and Keras neural networks
- [Learn PyTorch](https://learnopencv.com/learn-pytorch): PyTorch deep learning tutorial for beginners with neural networks
- [Learn Keras and TensorFlow](https://learnopencv.com/learn-keras-and-tensorflow): Keras and TensorFlow beginner guide for deep learning and CNNs

## Object Detection & Tracking

- [YOLOv26: Real-Time Deployment](https://learnopencv.com/yolov26-real-time-deployment): Guide to YOLOv26 edge-first object detector with quantization and real-time inference
- [YOLO26 NMS-Free Inference](https://learnopencv.com/yolo26-nms-free-inference): Article on YOLO26's NMS-free inference for real-time edge object detection
- [Multi-Object Tracking with Roboflow Trackers & OpenCV](https://learnopencv.com/multi-object-tracking-with-roboflow-trackers-and-opencv): Tutorial on multi-object tracking with ByteTrack, SORT, and Roboflow Trackers

## Face Detection & Processing

- [Real-Time Face Blur and Pixelation with OpenCV YuNet](https://learnopencv.com/face-blur-pixelation-opencv-yunet): Real-time face detection and anonymization using OpenCV YuNet in Python/C++
